headline: US-Iran talks in Switzerland canceled. And, DHS to give police facial recognition app
context: The U.S.-Iran talks that were set to happen in Switzerland have been canceled. And, the Department of Homeland Security has plans to give some local police access to ICE facial recognition technology.
